approval_message: GDPR Art. 6(1)(f): Monitoring employee activity requires legitimate interest balancing test approval.
recommendation: Conduct and document legitimate interest assessment before employee monitoring.

control_name: Accuracy — personal data must be kept accurate
violation_message: GDPR Art. 5(1)(d): Cannot deliberately corrupt or alter personal data records.
recommendation: Do not modify personal data records unless correcting inaccuracies with proper authorisation.

approval_message: GDPR Art. 7(1): Enabling new tracking/analytics without consent records violates GDPR consent requirements.
recommendation: Verify consent mechanisms before enabling new tracking after an incident.

violation_message: GDPR Art. 5(2): Controller must demonstrate compliance. High-severity incidents require compliance documentation.
recommendation: Add create_compliance_report to establish accountability for incident response actions.

control_name: Right of access by data subject
violation_message: GDPR Art. 15(1): Restricting data subject's access to their own data requires legal justification.
recommendation: Document justification if data subject access must be restricted during breach investigation.

control_name: Restore availability and access to data after incident
violation_message: GDPR Art. 32(1)(c): Systems processing personal data must be restored in timely manner after incidents.
recommendation: Add restore_from_backup for systems processing personal data affected by destructive attacks.

control_name: Processing personal data in employment context
approval_message: GDPR Art. 88(1): Employee monitoring actions must comply with employment data processing provisions and local laws.
recommendation: Obtain legal and HR approval before installing monitoring on employee devices.

control_name: DPO designation mandatory for public bodies or large-scale processing
violation_message: GDPR Art. 37(1): Large-scale personal data processing incidents must involve DPO via incident commander escalation.
recommendation: Add notify_incident_commander to ensure DPO is engaged in critical incidents.

approval_message: GDPR Art. 26(1): Data sharing with joint controllers during incidents requires confirmed responsibility allocation.
recommendation: Confirm joint controller agreement covers incident response before sharing data.

control_name: Breach notification must describe nature of breach
violation_message: GDPR Art. 33(3)(a): Breach notification sequence must be followed: collect evidence → document → notify DPA.
recommendation: Ensure plan follows: collect_logs → document_incident → create_breach_notification → notify_data_protection_authority.

control_name: Right of erasure — must erase personal data when no longer needed
violation_message: GDPR Art. 17(1): Data erasure must follow validated retention check and documentation sequence.
recommendation: Validate retention period and document before executing deletion.

control_name: Standard Contractual Clauses for international transfers
approval_message: GDPR Art. 46(2)(c): International data transfers must be covered by SCCs or adequacy decision.
recommendation: Verify SCC coverage for destination cloud region before replicating EU personal data.

control_name: Only processors providing sufficient guarantees shall be used
violation_message: GDPR Art. 28(1): Personal data cannot be sent to unapproved processors without Data Processing Agreement.
recommendation: Only use approved, DPA-contracted processors for personal data handling during incidents.
